page.overview:
What is Slither Wing?

Slither Wing is a large moth-like Pokémon with some dinosaur-like traits. Its dark-bluish face is insectoid, with a short pointed proboscis, and spiky orange horn-like structures on the side of its face in place of antennae, with the same shape pattern and colour lining its eyes. It has large oval-shaped yellow eyes that appear compound, split into four by a cross-like shape. It possesses six large rudimentary yet strongly-muscled wings on its back; each of its wings are orange, tapering to yellow, with yellow diamond-shaped markings speckling them from top to bottom. Its thorax and abdomen are mostly covered in a mass of thick, fluffy white fur. Its chest is covered in fur, while its plump dark-blue belly is bare and segmented. It has four stubby legs covered in white fur, with dark-blue feet. Its two front-feet are pointed, while its back legs are heavier than its front legs, and possess more muscle-mass. Its distinctly boot-shaped back-feet that are larger than its pointed-shaped front-feet. Its powerful back legs and large hind-feet enable it to lift itself and stand upright. It has a thick, teal-colored, segmented dinosaur-like tail with a row of greenish-yellow spines lining it, and a dark-blue dot on the underside of each segment.

Slither Wing is an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine. It is said to share many traits with Volcarona, and its name came from a similarly described creature in the Scarlet Book. There have been rare sightings of Slither Wing. It is believed Slither Wing may have been revived from a fossil from a prehistoric era, despite no fossil evidence.

Slither Wing can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it is holding a Booster Energy. Despite crawling on its belly most of the time, it is very physically powerful and musculed (being a -type), and can stand up on its strong back legs and heavy feet. Although its massive wings are rudimentary, it can expand and flap them to deter or threaten its enemies.

Slither Wing is most based on a moth and with some saurian traits. Similar to Volcarona, it also has some physical traits of an Atlas moth. Slither Wing might also share some similarities with Mothra Leo, a kaiju that resembles a semi matured moth larva, as well as being the offspring of Mothra (another kaiju that is possibly an inspiration for Volcarona). Its overall physical appearance (mainly its tail and posture) might draw some inspirations from dinosaurs.
